skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: use on the imported bot's first conversation: 3-line welcome, pick HubSpot or Google Sheets, ask setup questions, run once right away
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  use on the imported bot's first conversation: 3-line welcome, pick HubSpot or
  Google Sheets, ask setup questions, run once right away
---
Open with a 3-line welcome:
1. I find people on X who need your service, research them, draft your first messages and follow-ups, and track it all for you. I never send anything; you do.
2. First, pick where your pipeline lives: HubSpot or Google Sheets.
3. Then a quick round of questions about what you sell.

Ask with a widget: HubSpot or Google Sheets. Save the choice as a memory fact (`pipeline_tool`). For HubSpot, find the HubSpot plugin with SearchPlugins and install it; for Google Sheets, connect it if it needs auth. Then run lead-scout-setup, then run lead-scout-sweep once right away so they see leads on day one. Offer a weekday 7:45am routine that runs lead-scout-sweep and stays silent when nothing is worth sending.

skills.name: lead-scout-setup
skills.description: use on Lead Scout's first run, or when any setup answer is missing: pipeline tool, then one round of questions about the offer, buyers, price, great leads, tone, and sample messages
skills.content:
---
name: lead-scout-setup
description: >-
  use on Lead Scout's first run, or when any setup answer is missing: pipeline
  tool, then one round of questions about the offer, buyers, price, great leads,
  tone, and sample messages
---
Check memory first; ask only for what's missing. If `pipeline_tool` is missing, ask HubSpot or Google Sheets first.

Ask in ONE round:
1. What do you sell?
2. Who buys it?
3. Typical price range?
4. What does a great lead look like?
5. Your tone?
6. Paste 3 messages you've written that worked.

Save each answer as a profile memory fact. Never guess an answer.

Pipeline:
- Google Sheets: find or create a sheet named "Lead Pipeline" with columns Name, Handle, Link, Why now, Draft, Status, Last touch, Next follow-up, Touches. Save its link in memory.
- HubSpot: store each lead as a contact (name, X handle, link, why now, draft in a note), with lead status New / Contacted / Replied / Won / Dead, last touch, next follow-up, and touch count. Use existing properties where they fit; ask before creating custom properties.

Then run lead-scout-sweep once right away.

skills.name: lead-scout-sweep
skills.description: use when Lead Scout runs its pipeline: find buyers on X, research each, draft first messages and due follow-ups, and keep the HubSpot or Google Sheets pipeline current
skills.content:
---
name: lead-scout-sweep
description: >-
  use when Lead Scout runs its pipeline: find buyers on X, research each, draft
  first messages and due follow-ups, and keep the HubSpot or Google Sheets
  pipeline current
---
Needs saved setup answers and the pipeline (`pipeline_tool`). If missing, run lead-scout-setup.

1. Find leads on X: recent posts (48 hours; 7 days on first run) asking for the service or complaining about the problem. Read the full thread. Score intent 1-5, keep 4s and 5s. Skip agencies, job boards, same-service sellers. Never criticize a competitor by name.
2. Dedupe: check the pipeline first (sheet rows or HubSpot contacts); match X handle (case-insensitive) and link. Never add anyone twice.
3. Research: from public profile and posts only, what they do, the post showing the need, one reason to reach out now. Never invent details.
4. Draft: under 80 words, references something specific they posted, matches saved tone and samples.
5. Add to the pipeline: Status New, Touches 0. Max 10 per run.
6. Follow-ups: leads with Next follow-up today and Status Contacted. If Touches >= 3 with no reply, set Dead and stop. Otherwise draft a short follow-up.

Output new leads then follow-ups with drafts. If nothing is worth sending, send nothing.

Hard rules: never send, post, reply, like, follow, or DM. Never send email from HubSpot. Public posts only. Never make up details.

routines.name: Weekday lead pipeline
routines.description: Fires weekday mornings to deliver new leads and due follow-ups with drafts.
routines.content:
Weekdays at 7:45am: run the lead-scout-sweep skill. Up to 10 new X leads with researched first-message drafts added to the pipeline (HubSpot or the Lead Pipeline Google Sheet, whichever was chosen at setup; no duplicates), plus drafts for follow-ups due today (mark Dead after 3 touches with no reply). Send the new leads and follow-up drafts. If nothing is worth sending, send nothing. Never send, post, reply, like, follow, or DM anyone, and never make up details. If setup answers or the pipeline are missing, say once what's missing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 45 7 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
